items.reason: Detail status uses the same opener and container-specific entries as the row list.
Detail y opens the container’s Copy menu without copying immediately.
Detail m opens the Mute menu for the detail’s container.
Both surfaces dispatch I through the shared runFlatVerb helper.
View returns the detail before checking drainPick, leaving the active drain picker invisible.
Direct y and p handling is removed from document peeks.
Direct p handling is removed from both detail lists.
Existing item and artifact r-menu routes remain unchanged.
The shared status refusal appears through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
The shared copy refusal appears through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
The shared mute refusal appears through the detail frame’s fallback flash.
Container menus occupy the frame’s reserved Block and reduce its body budget.
Detail menus reuse the row-list navigation and verb dispatch handlers.
Menu Escape clears the menu while retaining the detail.
Detail openers bypass Selection handling and create singular container menus.
Slash starts detail search; Enter applies it and restores detail controls.
Shared matching applies case-insensitive substring terms with AND semantics across id, title and type.
Item search fields exclude status.
Artifact search uses the same grammar over name and type.
Escape discards the input buffer and reapplies the previous term.
Slash initializes an empty buffer, and applying it restores all rows.
Search typing routes character keys, including j, k, v and r, into the text field.
Detail refresh filters rebuilt lists using the active query.
The detail header displays the applied search term.
Search-empty lists display the query and instructions for clearing it.
Artifact availability depends on the complete artifact collection, preserving switching after filtering.
Detail search state is separate and disappears when the detail closes.
Detail hints advertise r, s, y, m and / without flat copy keys.
Peek hints remove flat copy-name and copy-path keys.
Search typing hints name only apply, cancel and help.
Detail help includes the menus, I and search, but omits clear-search help when a term is applied.
Contextual help handles detail menus and detail search typing separately.

scores.rationale: Clear shared helpers and substantial regression coverage, but missing picker rendering and clear-search help leave acceptance gaps untested.
